'''Grissom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Godling]], a member of the ruling class of the [[Anointed People]] from the planet [[Abonshee]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Looks like we've joined the Rebellion after all. Now, how do we get at those butchers down there?|Godking Trisstan|<ref name="Godking" />}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Abonshee|Masterhome]] was visited by [[Green squad]] of [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], an [[The Irregulars|Irregular]] branch of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who wanted the Anointed People to join their faction, even if the Anointed People did not have space-level technology. During the negotiations, a damaged [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Curich-class shuttle|''Curich''-class shuttle]], the [[Resurgence (Curich-class)|''Resurgence'']] landed near the [[Godking's castle|castle]] of the ruling [[Godking]], [[Trisstan]], to perform emergency repairs. Thirty [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] left the ship and immediately surrounded it.<ref name="Godking" />

[[Godking]] [[Trisstan]] ordered Grissom to approach the Imperial ship with a twenty-five being strong [[honor guard]] to question the new arrivals and determine their intent. Grissom obeyed and approached the ship, but a stormtrooper ordered him to stop. Grissom was confused, but he eventually kept walking, showing his hands were empty. The trooper shouted again, and then the Imperials fired on Grissom, his guard and any civilian in range, [[Death/Legends|killing]] them. This prompted Trisstan to join the Alliance to Restore the Republic and fight the Empire.<ref name="Godking" />
